summary: SEO platform with API and MCP access to keyword, backlink, SERP and rank-tracking data.
access_note: Data API is sold as annual credit packages; a free trial of the platform exists but the API plan is paid.
blocker_note: Data API credit plans are annual paid packages.

evidence.quote: Include an Authorization header in your request, with the value Token YOUR_API_KEY .
First, you’ll need to generate a unique API key from your account dashboard.
Our Data API credit plans are available as annual packages.
API access is included in every SE Ranking plan
This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address: Copy https://api.seranking.com/mcp

notes: Conflict: API landing page says API access is included in every plan and offers a free trial (no card), while the Data API getting-started page sells credits as annual packages (12M credits is $2,148/yr). Kept paid_plan because the Data API needs a paid credits package; whether the free trial includes working API credits was not verified. REST is shown by HTTPS endpoints (api.seranking.com/v1/...), the word REST is not on the page. MCP is official and supports OAuth 2.1 or an X-Api-Key header.
